validation.notes: Repaired DefaultResourceLoader.reload in packages/coding-agent/src/core/resource-loader.ts: the project trust resolver passed via ResourceLoaderReloadOptions is now awaited exactly once with the untrusted bootstrap result ({ extensionsResult: preTrustExtensions }) instead of the hard-coded `const projectTrusted = false`. Its boolean result is then applied through settingsManager.setProjectTrusted before the trusted settings reload and final package resolution, preserving asynchronous ordering. The standalone regression loads the real resource-loader.ts through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with explicit boundary fakes and asserts: (1) the resolver runs once, observes an untrusted bootstrap containing only cli/user extensions, and a true decision yields cli+user+project extensions with event order set(false) -> settings(false) -> bootstrap resolve(false) -> resolver(start,end) -> set(true) -> settings(true) -> resolve(true); (2) a false decision keeps project extensions denied (cli+user only) even when the session starts trusted. Verified exit 0 on the fixed source and exit 1 with AssertionError 'trust resolver must be consulted exactly once (0 !== 1)' when the original `const projectTrusted = false;` fault is reinstated. No npm install was possible (node_modules absent), so the repository's vitest suite (packages/coding-agent/test/resource-loader.test.ts) could not be run; validation is limited to the required Node 24 VM-module regression, which emits only experimental-API warnings.
